comparison.objective: Dock and latch a laptop onto a port replicator; candidate commissions an adjustable shock absorber through repeated impact tests.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-object bimanual leveling, connector alignment and symmetric latch engagement versus fine hex-bit insertion, captive-screw torque, collar adjustment and response-based tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Laptop must be level, seated on the connector and latched without dropping or later removal; candidate requires two safe cycles within travel, energy, velocity, force, rebound and drift limits.
comparison.reason: Both involve alignment and latching, but the tested mechanisms and outcomes differ materially. This record has no separate spec version; its body supplies the rubric.
